base_prompt: Write to the organizer of a neighborhood cleanup explaining that you can help with sorting supplies but cannot stay for the whole event. Aim for about 120 words.
text: Hi, I’d be happy to help with the neighborhood cleanup, especially by sorting and organizing supplies before everyone gets started. I can arrive early to separate gloves, bags, tools, recycling materials, and any other equipment so volunteers can quickly find what they need. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to stay for the entire event because I have another commitment later that day. I can still contribute for the first couple of hours and make sure the supply area is orderly before I leave. Please let me know what time you’d like me to arrive and whether there are any specific sorting tasks you’d like me to handle. I’m glad to support the effort and help the cleanup get off to a smooth start.
